svg.title: 5. A lantern can keep rising after its flame goes out
svg.desc: Calculated lifecycle example with rise 1.5 m/s, sink 1 m/s, flame-out at 30 seconds, cooling time 20 seconds and initial height 100 m. Speed crosses zero at 48.3 seconds, where altitude reaches its maximum.

g.text: 5. A lantern can keep rising after its flame goes out
vRise = 1.5 m/s · vSink = 1.0 m/s · τ = 20 s · h(0) = 100 m
Teaching example calculated from the lifecycle equations; it is not an Aguadilla measurement.
